name: Steel Shield: Is this a scam?
description: One click on any email: Looks safe, Be careful or Looks like a scam, with the reasons in plain English. Checks the sender, where every link really goes, attachments and the wording, on your computer. One more click reports a scam to the anti-phishing groups and Google, so it gets blocked for everyone.
author: Steel & Code and Blackbox Entertainment
